entities.name: Serving PLMN rate control
entities.description: Information element that indicates the maximum number of uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval.

entities.name: ESM DATA TRANSPORT message
entities.description: Uplink ESM message used for data transport.

entities.name: User data container IE
entities.description: Information element contained within ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages.

entities.name: Network wishes to apply rate control
entities.description: Condition when the network wishes to indicate rate control parameters to the UE.

relations.description: The Serving PLMN rate control IE is included when the network wishes to apply rate control.
ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages contain User data container IEs.
The Serving PLMN rate control IE governs the maximum number of uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages allowed per interval.
